dims.label: Mission match
dims.question: How directly does this program fund what SALSAV does?

levels.label: Agrivoltaics named
levels.rule: The call or the program priorities name agrivoltaics, dual-use solar or solar combined with farming.

levels.label: Direct nexus
levels.rule: Funds the water-energy-food nexus, solar or renewable energy for agriculture, or dryland and semi-arid farming resilience.

levels.label: Adjacent field
levels.rule: Funds a wider field (climate adaptation, sustainable agriculture, clean energy access, food security) where an agrivoltaics project is a natural proposal.

levels.label: Tangential
levels.rule: Only a general link (environment, development, education); agrivoltaics would be a stretch.

levels.label: No match
levels.rule: Does not fund this kind of work.

dims.label: Type of work funded
dims.question: Does it pay for the kind of work a university lab does?

levels.label: Research and demonstration
levels.rule: Funds applied research, field trials or demonstration sites led by research institutions.

levels.label: Deployment and training
levels.rule: Funds deployment, training, extension, education or capacity building where a university lab can lead a work package.

levels.label: Other work
levels.rule: Mostly policy, advocacy, finance or service delivery; SALSAV could only be a minor partner.

levels.label: Mismatch
levels.rule: Funds work a university lab cannot take part in.

dims.label: Where the work can happen
dims.question: Does the funded geography overlap SALSAV sites and partners?

levels.label: SALSAV home ground
levels.rule: Targets Arizona, the US Southwest, or a place where SALSAV already has a site or partner (Mexico, Kenya, Israel).

levels.label: Same region
levels.rule: US-wide, or Latin America or Sub-Saharan Africa as a whole.

levels.label: Global
levels.rule: Global or multi-region; SALSAV geographies are allowed but not prioritized.

levels.label: Outside the footprint
levels.rule: Focused on places where SALSAV has no site; would need a new local partner.

levels.label: Excluded
levels.rule: SALSAV geographies cannot be funded.

dims.label: Can the University of Arizona apply
dims.question: Can UA be the applicant or a funded partner?

levels.label: UA applies directly
levels.rule: A US public university can be the lead applicant.

levels.label: With a partner
levels.rule: UA can take part, but a required partner or a different lead organization is needed.

levels.label: Not confirmed
levels.rule: The official page does not say whether universities can apply.

levels.label: By invitation
levels.rule: No open application; a relationship with the funder comes first.

levels.label: Not eligible
levels.rule: Universities or US applicants are excluded.

dims.label: Award size
dims.question: How large is the largest single award?

levels.label: $1M or more
levels.rule: Largest single award is at least $1,000,000.

levels.label: $500k to $1M
levels.rule: Largest single award is between $500,000 and $1,000,000.

levels.label: $200k to $500k
levels.rule: Largest single award is between $200,000 and $500,000.

levels.label: Not published
levels.rule: The funder does not publish award sizes.

levels.label: Below $200k
levels.rule: Largest single award is under $200,000.

dims.label: Track record
dims.question: Has this funder backed similar work before?

levels.label: Funded this before
levels.rule: Has funded agrivoltaics, or the University of Arizona or a SALSAV partner on related work.

levels.label: Funded similar work
levels.rule: Has funded comparable university-led dryland agriculture, solar or water projects.

levels.label: None found
levels.rule: No relevant precedent found.
